adaptations: The original ten missions become the fixed good-side route. All three equipment alternatives are preserved only in Source; Armor is the single authored choice. Team-wave timings and transit prerequisite branches are simplified, not guessed storage aliases. Source dialogue/journal facts remain unchanged.
source_notes: This is an explicitly chosen Oteryn finite programme supplementary to the existing original SourceQuest identity. The original missions, interactions, claims, gates and UNKNOWN holds are retained; no duplicate canonical quest is created.

All quantities, requirement thresholds, sequencing, repeat policy and reward delivery are CHOSEN_OTERYN_APPROXIMATION, even when the same name or number occurs in a pinned source. Entity names are unresolved authored binding requests, never fabricated native IDs, Lua symbols or storage aliases.

Completion concerns only this chosen recipe. Unselected optional branches, full source fidelity, drop rates, original schedules, transport logic and executable Native delivery are not certified. Intermediate collect/use stages acquire and consume their own tools; reward_intents lists only final or stated milestone grants.
Original source identity: canary:quest/in_service_of_yalahar_quest@canary-04b83b51+crystalserver-9f5a72c6; inherited source pins and catalogue title links are preserved exactly.

stages.objective: Accept Palimuth's sewer-repair mission in Yalahar.
Clear the four marked sewer pipes with a crowbar.
Report to all seven quarter guards along the chosen route.
Defeat the three plague bearers in the Alchemist Quarter.
Recover the Alchemists' Formulas and deliver them to Palimuth.
Negotiate peacefully with Mr. West in the Trade Quarter.
Obtain one Animal Cure for Tamerin's animals.
Defeat Morik the Gladiator and recover his helmet as proof.
Give Tamerin the cure and proof, then choose cattle for Palimuth.
Charge the Ghost Charm at the Strange Carving and give it to Palimuth to free the souls.
Ask Maritima why the Quara have become aggressive.
Obtain the Pattern Crystal and configure the Factory Quarter to supply food.
Confirm support for Palimuth's civilian plan.
Enter the inner sanctum and stop Azerus' ritual.
Report victory and choose the Yalahari Armor reward.
Record the completion of the chosen In Service of Yalahar Quest programme and its selected reward intents.

recipe.summary: Support Palimuth's civilian reforms and stop Azerus' demonic ritual in Yalahar.
